Container.Name: ollama-cursor-agent
Container.Overview: Local Cursor-style coding agent: chat UI, file tools, shell, and optional GitHub branch/PR workflow — powered by Ollama on your Unraid box.[br][br]1. Install [b]ollama[/b] and pull a coding model.[br]2. Set [b]Ollama Base URL[/b] to [b]http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:11434[/b].[br]3. Mount [b]Workspace[/b] (git clone) and [b]Agent data[/b] for saved GitHub repo choice.[br]4. Set [b]GitHub Token[/b] only — pick the repo in the Web UI (v0.2.2+).[br][br]If Docker does not show an update: [b]docker pull ghcr.io/killamfkr/ollama-cursor-agent:latest[/b] then recreate the container. Check version: [b]/api/config[/b] → [b]version[/b] = 0.2.2.
Container.Changes: v0.2.2 — GHCR registry URL for update checks, template refresh, /api/config version field. Pull image manually if Docker shows no update.

Config.Name: Workspace
Config.Description: Host folder mounted as the agent sandbox — use an empty folder or a git clone of your project (clone is required for push/PR)

Config.Name: Agent data
Config.Description: Persists GitHub repo picker and UI state across container recreates

Config.Name: Ollama Base URL
Config.Description: Ollama API URL reachable from this container (usually http://UNRAID-IP:11434)

Config.Name: Default Model
Config.Description: Ollama model name (must be pulled in the Ollama container first)

Config.Name: Data dir
Config.Description: Path inside container for persisted UI state (match Agent data mount)

Config.Name: GitHub Token
Config.Description: PAT with repo scope — required for GitHub; repo is chosen in the Web UI

Config.Name: GitHub Repo
Config.Description: Optional lock to owner/name — leave empty and pick the repo in the Web UI (recommended)

Config.Name: GitHub Trigger Label
Config.Description: Issue label that starts the agent

Config.Name: GitHub Comment Trigger
Config.Description: Issue comment that starts the agent

Config.Name: Public Base URL
Config.Description: Public URL for webhook docs (e.g. https://agent.example.com)
